text: やさしい　カラカラの　おかあさんに　もどった　たましいは　ぶじ　てんに　のぼって…　…　…きえて　いきました

structure.jp: やさしい　カラカラの　おかあさんに　もどった　たましいは
structure.en: the soul, which had returned to being Cubone's gentle mother

structure.jp: ぶじ　てんに　のぼって…

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: やさしい　カラカラの　おかあさんに　もどった　たましい
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. やさしい　カラカラの　おかあさんに　もどった　たましい = 'the soul that turned back into Cubone's gentle mother'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.span: きえて　いきました
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says the thing happens little by little, moving away. きえて　いきました = 'faded away'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. てんに　のぼって = 'rose to heaven and'.
